title.en: MALACAÑANG BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES REINSTATING THE DEPARTMENT OF AGRARIAN REFORM, DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT AND DEPARTMENT OF HEALTH AS MEMBERS OF THE REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT COUNCIL

text.en:
The Regional Directors of DAR, DOH and DILG shall remain
members of the RDC.

All previous issuances inconsistent with the provisions of
this Executive Order are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 28th of August
year of Our Lord, Two Thousand and Six.
Glow' Mr. Arres
By the President:
EDUARBHU R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
POMA Hologram # 36721
